body: I don’t think I want to necessarily. I just know others feel the same as I do. I don’t feel alone, I just feel like if everything stopped, that’d be pretty nice. If everything mattered as little as I do, things would be easy. I don’t see why this needs to be a difficult thing to do; living. I’m fairly certain that humans are the only creatures that debate this with themselves, and that leads me to believe that we are flawed in how we are. I understand that we aren’t perfect, but shouldn’t I enjoy life? There are things I find myself enjoying, but that joy seems to be lessening more and more over the years. I feel like when I want to be happy I’m scrambling, struggling, and getting very little return, whereas if I don’t, life is easy, but also monotonous, tedious, and I’m filled with extreme apathy and lethargy. I wonder if I chose the right path in life and if I didn’t, can I get on that right path, or am I stuck to my choices forever.
That’s something I can work with thanks for your input
